inputs.description: closed-form (no RNG): z[i,j,c] = bf16(3 sin(0.37 i + 0.11 c) + 2 cos(0.23 j - 0.07 c) + 0.5 sin(0.013 i j + 0.5 c)); mask[i,j] = ((7 i + 3 j) mod 11 != 0); weights = sin lattices scaled 1/16; LayerNorm gamma = 1 + 0.25 sin(a c), beta = 0.1 cos(a c) (a = 0.09 in / 0.07 out)

cases.name: k1
cases.call: ops.k1(z, mask, w) -> planes [512, 160, 160] bf16 (fast path: LayerNorm_in + gated dual projection, padded planes)

cases.name: k3
cases.call: ops.k3(x_fixed, z, w, residual=True) with x_fixed = bf16(0.5 planes[:256] + 0.25 flip(planes[256:], 0)) -> [160,160,256] bf16

cases.name: k1s
cases.call: ops.k1_stock_order(z, mask, w) -> [512,160,160] bf16 unpadded planes, LayerNorm in the stock kernels' order (exact tier)

cases.name: k3s2
cases.call: ops.k3(x_fixed[:, :160, :160].contiguous(), z, w, residual=True, lnmode=2) -> [160,160,256] bf16 (exact tier; the N % 4 == 0 tree of the stock transposing LayerNorm)

cases.name: k3s3
cases.call: ops.k3(x_fixed[:, :160, :160].contiguous(), z, w, residual=True, lnmode=3) -> [160,160,256] bf16 (exact tier; the N % 4 != 0 tree, numerically valid at any N)

cases.name: bmm
cases.call: ops.bmm(planes, outgoing=True) -> [256,160,160] bf16 (cuBLAS; informational: another cuBLAS may choose another kernel)

digest: sha256 over the output tensor's raw bytes (contiguous, bf16 viewed as uint8), first 32 hex digits; computed by ops._digest; the same cases run at every load (ops._loadcheck) against prebuilt/manifest.json 'loadcheck'
real_shape_evidence: bitwise identities on recorded 400/800/1400-token activations were checked at development time (not shippable as bytes: 40-500 M elements per tensor)
